title: Europe’s Hidden Trade Advantage
gist: Jonas Nahm argues that the EU's slow, rules-based approach is a hidden advantage: while Trump's bids for a 51st state were rebuffed, the EU's accession queue is the longest in decades and negotiations are moving with urgency unseen since 2004. Only the opening of the paywalled essay is available.

insights.claim: The European Union's membership queue is the longest it has been in decades, and accession negotiations are advancing with an urgency not seen since the bloc's last major expansion in 2004.
insights.speaker: Jonas Nahm
insights.so_what: Enlargement expands the EU single market and eventual structural-fund flows eastward; watch candidate-country assets for convergence trades.
